messages:
Maya: Heads-up — QBR with AtlasOps scheduled Tue 2025-10-14 3:00pm PT. Need: slide deck (10min exec summary + 15min ops deep-dive), single-page exec ask, top-5 risks with owners, onboarding status snapshot, and enablement follow-ups. Who can own what?

Evan: I can own the slides + metrics. Will include token cost trend + latency P50/P95.

Noah: I'll pull onboarding status, open onboarding tickets, activation % and enablement attendance.

Jordan: I'll draft the renewal ask + 3 pricing options; will coordinate with finance. @Evan can you add revenue impact chart?

Maya: @Jordan yes please. Also need one slide with recommended fallback plan if latency > SLO (ops ask).

Evan: Got it. Deck outline I'm going to follow:
```
1) Exec summary (1 slide)
2) Key metrics & trends (traffic, cost, latency P50/P95)
3) Onboarding + enablement status (activation funnel, blockers)
4) Renewal ask + pricing options (3 bullets)
5) Risks & mitigations (owners + ETA)
6) Next steps & asks (1 page)
```

Noah: Action items (quick):
- Evan: first slide draft by Fri EOD
- Jordan: renewal ask draft by Mon noon
- Noah: onboarding snapshot + ticket list by Fri
- Maya: sync with AE for final exec asks by Mon

Priya: quick reminder — include customer feedback on docs and training; there are 2 gating items raised in last week (search doc accuracy + role-based examples).

Maya: +1 include that in "enablement blockers" slide. Also let's run a 30-minute dry-run Tue 11am PT before the QBR.

qbr-bot: Reminder created: QBR dry-run Tue 11:00 PT (assigned: Maya, Evan, Jordan, Noah)

Evan: Will upload first draft here when ready: https://drive.redwood/example-deck (expect Fri am).

Jordan: tagging finance for final numbers @Lina — can you send FYI on renewal tier impacts?

Lina: Copy — will send model + ARR delta by Mon 9am.

Maya: Thanks — please also add who on exec we should call out as supporter. If anyone sees a blocker, ping me or drop in #customer-success. :thumbsup:

Noah: I'll produce a one-page ops health snapshot for the exec ask (2nd slide).

Evan: FYI I'll include a small table showing cost/latency tradeoffs for quantization + a short note on recommended default.

Maya: Perfect. Closing notes: keep comments inline on the deck, and we'll triage during dry-run.

Evan: 👍

Jordan: 👍

Noah: 👍
